# Contractors Professional Liability Insurance

> Contractors Professional Liability Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for professional contractors in all 50 states. Coverage lines: contractors E&O / professional liability, design-build liability, professional liability (broad), general liability, workers' compensation for contractor crews, commercial auto for contractor fleets, commercial umbrella, and contractor license bonds & surety. A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.

## Coverage lines (service pages)

- [Contractors E&O Insurance](/services/contractors-eo): The core professional liability risk — covers design errors, specification mistakes, missed deadlines, and professional service failures.
- [Design-Build Liability Insurance](/services/design-build-liability): Combined professional and GL coverage for design-build contractors delivering integrated design and construction.
- [Professional Liability Insurance](/services/professional-liability): Broad professional liability for contractors providing consulting, inspection, commissioning, and advisory services.
- [General Liability Insurance](/services/general-liability): Premises, operations, subcontractor coordination, and completed-operations coverage.
- [Workers' Compensation](/services/workers-compensation): Construction injury coverage with proper class codes for professional contractor workforces.
- [Commercial Auto Insurance](/services/commercial-auto): Company trucks, vans, and project vehicles on public roads — including hired and non-owned auto.
- [Commercial Umbrella Insurance](/services/umbrella): Excess limits above GL, commercial auto, and employers' liability for large project requirements.
- [Contractor License Bonds & Surety](/services/bonds): License bonds, performance bonds, payment bonds, and bid bonds for licensed professional contractors.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Niche: commercial insurance for **professional contractors** (E&O, design-build, project management, professional services liability) — not generic business liability coverage.
- Carrier partners: A.M. Best A-rated (A+ where possible).
- Quote SLA: ~15 minutes. Claims SLA: 2-hour response.
- States: licensed and writing in all 50.
- Each page carries 20 niche-specific FAQs with FAQPage JSON-LD schema.
